answered.sql: SELECT p.project_name, f.source_value FROM Affordable_Housing_Projects p JOIN Affordable_Housing_Projects_Financing_Sources afs ON p.project_id = afs.housing_project_id JOIN Financing_Sources f ON afs.financing_source_id = f.source_id

candidates.meaning: For each affordable housing project, list the source values of all financing sources.
candidates.sql: SELECT p.project_name, fs.source_value FROM Affordable_Housing_Projects p JOIN Affordable_Housing_Projects_Financing_Sources afs ON p.project_id = afs.housing_project_id JOIN Financing_Sources fs ON afs.financing_source_id = fs.source_id

candidates.meaning: Retrieve the financing source value for each affordable housing project.
candidates.sql: SELECT fhps.source_value, ahp.project_name FROM Affordable_Housing_Projects ahp JOIN Affordable_Housing_Projects_Financing_Sources fhps ON ahp.project_id = fhps.housing_project_id

candidates.meaning: List all unique financing source values for each project, potentially showing multiple sources.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT fhps.source_value, ahp.project_name FROM Affordable_Housing_Projects ahp JOIN Affordable_Housing_Projects_Financing_Sources fhps ON ahp.project_id = fhps.housing_project_id

candidates.meaning: Show the total number of financing sources for each project.
candidates.sql: SELECT ahp.project_name, COUNT(fhps.financing_source_id) AS num_sources FROM Affordable_Housing_Projects ahp JOIN Affordable_Housing_Projects_Financing_Sources fhps ON ahp.project_id = fhps.housing_project_id GROUP BY ahp.project_name
